title: llm-number-choice: code and data for "3, 7, 14, 17, 42: Instruction Tuning Installs and Sharpens Number-Choice Heuristics in Language Models"
description: Code and data for computing, by exact enumeration rather than sampling, the probability that 18 open-weight language models assign to each integer from 1 to N when asked for a random number, before and after instruction tuning.
